title: Stationary comparison characterized on actual filtered cycles
statement: Let C be an abelian category, K an integer-indexed cochain complex and F a decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration]. Fix integers q,p,r with r>=1, F^(q+r) K^(q+p+1)=0 and F^(q-r+1) K^(q+p-1)=K^(q+p-1) [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Let c:H^(q+p)(K)≅Y and H a decreasing filtration of Y. For every i suppose an epimorphism a_i:H^(q+p)(F^i K)→H.step i is given with a_i followed by the inclusion equal to H^(q+p)(F^i K→K) followed by c. Then there exist an epimorphism z from actual cycles of F^q K in degree q+p to the graded r-cycles and an isomorphism e from their page cokernel [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential] to gr^q H, such that z followed by the graded-cycle inclusion is the actual-cycle inclusion followed by graded projection, and z followed by page projection and e equals the homology projection followed by a_q and the successive-step cokernel projection. These equations uniquely specify z and e.

source.place: Tags 012K, 012Q and 012W: cycle/boundary quotients, graded image filtration, degreewise finite convergence

proof.text: Construct z by factoring the actual-cycle inclusion through the defining graded-cycle image. Apply filteredComplex_differential_representatives_cover at (q,p) and (q+r,p+1-r). The upper bound makes the target filtration inclusion zero, so the covering representative t has zero differential. Lift t through actual cycles; monicity of the graded-cycle inclusion identifies its composite with z with the epic covering map x. Therefore z is epic and has the required inclusion equation.

Write n=q+p, A=F^qK^n, A′=F^(q+1)K^n, Z=ker d^n, B=im d^(n-1), S=A intersect Z, D=(A intersect B)+(A′ intersect Z). In the private helpers filtered_cycles_image and cycles_subobject, prove directly by kernel lifts that actual cycles identify with S and ambient cycles with Z. In filtered_class_preimage, use homology naturality and epimorphy to identify the next cohomology-image step with the image of A′ intersect Z under the ambient class map. Its inverse image is B+(A′ intersect Z): the ambient class map is a cokernel of its kernel. Restrict to S and use the modular law to obtain D. The supporting private declarations map_pullback_mono, pullback_exists_isCokernel and subobject_modular are reused from the normalized-presentation module via a proof-only import all; its Nonempty presentation theorem is not applied.

In stationary_projection_kernel, use the lower bound to replace graded r-boundaries by the graded image of (A intersect B)+A′. The degreewise cokernel inverse-image formula filtered_preimage from the normalized-presentation module, followed by the modular law, identifies the kernel of z followed by page projection with the inverse image of D on actual cycles. The epic factorization a_i and ha identify H.step i with the image filtration transported by c. Pulling the next-step cokernel kernel back and using filtered_class_preimage identifies the kernel of homology projection followed by a_q and graded projection with that same subobject. The quotient_kernel calculation reuses the existing private BigradedExactCouple.pullback_kernelSubobject theorem from DerivedCoupleKernelIdentities via a proof-only import all; no local duplicate is stated.

Both projections from actual cycles are epic. Equality of their kernel subobjects makes each vanish on the other kernel inclusion. Apply Mathlib Abelian.epiDesc in each direction; comp_epiDesc gives the projection equation, and cancelling the two epimorphisms proves the composites are identities. Thus epi_iso_of_kernel_eq supplies the required comparison isomorphism. Combine it with z and its inclusion equation. No uniform boundedness, chosen witness of mere existence, or object-only stationary isomorphism is used.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredStationary_cycle_comparison
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K)
    (q p r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hupper : F.complexStep (q + r) (q + p + 1) = ⊥)
    (hlower : F.complexStep (q - r + 1) (q + p - 1) = ⊤)
    {Y : C} (c : K.homology (q + p) ≅ Y) (H : DecreasingFiltration Y)
    (a : ∀ i : ℤ, (F.step i : CochainComplex C ℤ).homology (q + p) ⟶ (H.step i : C))
    (ha : ∀ i : ℤ, a i ≫ (H.step i).arrow =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.step i).arrow (q + p) ≫ c.hom)
    (hepi : ∀ i : ℤ, Epi (a i)) :
    ∃ (z : (F.step q : CochainComplex C ℤ).cycles (q + p) ⟶
        (F.complexCycles q (q + p) r : C))
      (e : filteredComplexPageObject K F r (q, p) ≅ H.gradedPiece q),
      Epi z ∧
      z ≫ (F.complexCycles q (q + p) r).arrow =
        (F.step q : CochainComplex C ℤ).iCycles (q + p) ≫
          (F.complexQuotientπ q (q + 1) (by omega)).f (q + p) ∧
      z ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r (q, p) ≫ e.hom =
        (F.step q : CochainComplex C ℤ).homologyπ (q + p) ≫ a q ≫
          cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (H.step (q + 1)) (H.step q)
            (H.antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q))))
